name: Сверка транзакций парка (Fleet API → PostgreSQL → отчёт)

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO etl_runs (run_id, for_date, status) VALUES ($1, $2::date, 'running')
ON CONFLICT (run_id) DO UPDATE SET status = 'running', started_at = now()
RETURNING run_id, for_date::text AS for_date, $3::text AS park_id, $4::text AS client_id, $5::jsonb AS body

WITH x AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb)
    AS t(txn_id text, driver_id text, event_at timestamptz, category text, amount numeric)
), up AS (
  INSERT INTO fleet_txn (txn_id, driver_id, event_at, category, amount, for_date)
  SELECT txn_id, driver_id, event_at, category, amount, $2::date FROM x
  ON CONFLICT (txn_id) DO UPDATE
    SET amount = EXCLUDED.amount, category = EXCLUDED.category, loaded_at = now()
    WHERE fleet_txn.amount IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.amount
       OR fleet_txn.category IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.category
  RETURNING (xmax = 0) AS inserted
), rej AS (
  INSERT INTO fleet_txn_rejected (run_id, for_date, txn_id, reason, raw)
  SELECT $3, $2::date, r->>'txn_id', r->>'reason', r->'raw'
  FROM jsonb_array_elements($4::jsonb) r
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT $3::text AS run_id, $2::text AS for_date, $5::int AS fetched, $6::int AS valid,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE inserted)     AS inserted,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT inserted) AS updated,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM rej)           AS rejected
FROM up;

UPDATE etl_runs SET status = 'ok', finished_at = now(),
  fetched = $2, inserted = $3, updated = $4, rejected = $5
WHERE run_id = $1
RETURNING run_id, for_date::text AS for_date

SELECT driver_id, count(*) AS txns, sum(amount) AS total
FROM fleet_txn WHERE for_date = $1::date
GROUP BY driver_id ORDER BY total DESC
